summary: Every quit writes one log line naming its source: the menu or Cmd+Q, the Relaunch button, the updater install, the last window closing (Windows and Linux), the single-instance lock, a fatal startup error, the smoke test, a SIGTERM/SIGINT/SIGHUP signal, or a macOS shutdown or logout. A quit with no in-app caller logs as system (the Dock, a macOS quit Apple event, or an untagged path). Added after a user's app quit cleanly with no trace of why.

reactNativeIos.reason: The phone app has no quit path of the desktop app; this is desktop main-process logging.

nativeAndroid.reason: The native Android client has no desktop quit path; this is desktop main-process logging.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No IPC or wire change; the headless server keeps its own signal handling.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data; one extra log line per quit.

updateRelease.reason: The updater install path only gains a log tag; packaging and channels are unchanged.

automated: quit-source.test.ts: system default, first reason wins, empty detail omitted. Typecheck covers the tagged call sites.
notExercised: A real Cmd+Q, Dock quit, SIGTERM and macOS logout on the packaged app were not triggered by a test; the release smoke test exercises the quit path.
